reason: shadcn's calendar.tsx wraps react-day-picker 10.0.2 (on date-fns 4.1.0), a React-only library. The port may not ship react-day-picker, date-fns or any other date library (maintainer constraint of the phlex-shadcn-adoption epic), so the shadcn--calendar Stimulus controller re-implements rdp's grid, focus, keyboard and selection model with native Date and Intl and renders rdp's DOM (including the rdp-* class names) exactly. The differences are the ones a server-rendered port without that library needs: (1) the server renders the root, the months container and the nav (so a Popover's focus scope finds the same first tabbable as React) and the controller renders the rest on connect, from an inert <template> of prototypes that keeps every class string in Ruby, plus hidden inputs for name:; none of these has a data-slot, classes on a box or text, so the compared DOM is unchanged after connect; (2) text and labels are reproduced exactly only for the locales nil/en/en-US and es: rdp formats with date-fns patterns and ships per-locale label translations, which Intl cannot reproduce for every locale, so other tags get Intl approximations and English labels; (3) function-valued props (formatters, components, function matchers, callbacks) cannot cross from Ruby, so they become data (Intl option hashes, matcher hashes) or events; (4) the standalone Calendar::DayButton is server-rendered and cannot read the browser locale or focus itself; (5) the DatePicker is a documented Popover + Calendar composition (no oracle component) with port-only form wiring kwargs. allow_tokens lists the words of the English and Spanish label sentences (rdp locale labels): they are text, but G1 reads any string of four or more plain words as a class list.
api: formatters: takes Intl.DateTimeFormat option hashes (optional locale:) per formatter key instead of functions; only format_caption, format_day, format_month_dropdown, format_weekday_name and format_year_dropdown are accepted
components: accepts only nil or {} (render overrides are not portable); anything else raises ArgumentError
disabled:, hidden: and modifiers: values are data matchers only (dates, arrays, from/to, before/after, day_of_week, booleans); function matchers raise ArgumentError

Callbacks become events: onSelect -> shadcn--calendar:select { selected, date, modifiers }, onMonthChange -> shadcn--calendar:month-change { month }; onDayClick, onDayFocus, onDayBlur, onDayKeyDown, onDayMouseEnter, onDayMouseLeave, onNextClick and onPrevClick are not ported
selected: is always the initial value (React semantics when no onSelect is passed); there is no controlled selection
month: is controlled like rdp without onMonthChange; the caller moves it by setting data-shadcn--calendar-month-value

Not ported: labels, styles, modifiersStyles, timeZone, noonSafe, dateLib, numerals, ISOWeek, broadcastCalendar, firstWeekContainsDate, useAdditionalWeekYearTokens, useAdditionalDayOfYearTokens, navLayout, reverseMonths, reverseYears, animate, nonce, initialFocus, ref

Locales other than nil/en/en-US/es: day labels use Intl dateStyle full, weekday headers Intl short names unsliced, nav/dropdown/week-number/today/selected labels stay English, firstWeekContainsDate comes from Intl weekInfo.minimalDays or 1 (rdp uses date-fns patterns and its own translations)

Calendar::DayButton rendered standalone writes data-day in the en-US M/D/YYYY form (React uses the browser's toLocaleDateString()) and does not focus itself for modifiers: { focused: true }; inside the Calendar the controller uses the real values
Port-only kwargs name:, input:, label:, close_on_select: wire the calendar to forms and to an enclosing Popover (DatePicker composition); they have no React counterpart
The root forwards every **attrs key (R6); rdp forwards only id, lang, nonce, title, role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, style and data-*
structure: root children besides div.rdp-months: one inert <template data-shadcn--calendar-target="parts"> with the part prototypes and, with name:, hidden inputs (no data-slot, no box)

the nav and its buttons are server-rendered with a best-effort disabled state (computed from today: or the server date) and re-synced by the controller on connect; months, captions, dropdowns and the grid are rendered by the controller; the footer is server-rendered
Stimulus wiring on the root (data-controller, data-shadcn--calendar-*-value) and on the label element of the DatePicker composition (data-shadcn--calendar-placeholder, data-empty)
